rules.statement: Trial judges must provide reasoned answers to points of contest admitted to trial in compliance with section 187 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. It is to be observed that there is nothing in the record to infer that a settlement was arrived upon. 2. In such circumstances firstly, the trial judge should have answered the points of contest after due evaluation of the available evidence. 3. The trial judge has totally failed to answer any of the points of contest admitted to trial. 198 Held further: 4 Bare answers without reasons to issues or points of contest raised at a trial are not in compliance with the requirements of section 187 of the Civil Procedure Code
